definitions.full: H2727. charag [ חָרַג ] verb quake (compare (si vera lectio) Arabic be straitened, unable to move for fear and rage (Lane), also put oneself in a rage (Dozy); מוֺתָא חַרְגַת ᵑ7 Deut 32:25 terror of death ) — only Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural מִמִּסְגְּרוֺתֵיהֶם וְיַחְרְגוּ Psa 18:46 pregnantly and come quaking out of their fortresses (compare יִרְגְּזוּ in like connection Micah 7:17 ); read the same also in || 2Sam 22:46 (for וְיַחְגְרוּ ᵑ0 , see חגר ; possible would be also ויחרדו in both, as Hosea 11:10-11 , etc.) חרגל (quadriliteral √ of following; compare Arabic run right and left, run swiftly (Frey)).
